title: plan.readiness_verdict reply
description: Reply of the plan.readiness_verdict op: the prep gate computed in-process plus the mechanical readiness verdict. verdict 'ready' with empty mechanical_repairs means no prep-gate or readiness agent is owed. Spec: coordinator_core/contract/readiness-verdict-producer-contract.md.

plan.description: Repo-relative path of the plan the verdict was computed over.

verdict.description: ready: nothing owed. pulled: the plan must be revised before it is ready. judgment: a reviewer verdict or a judgment finding needs an agent.

pull_class.description: none when verdict is ready or judgment without a pull; mechanical when every pulling finding is repaired by mechanical_repairs; substantive otherwise (full re-review path).

mechanical_repairs.description: Targeted revisions a revise block applies without a second review round. Empty unless pull_class is mechanical.

target.description: Row id, section or plan path the repair edits.

prep_gate.description: The plan.prep_gate reply, verbatim (verdict PREPPED | NOT-PREPPED | REFUSED, withheld_rows, classes, message, stamp, engine_build). classes, stamp and engine_build are deliberately untyped objects: passthrough of plan.prep_gate, whose schema owns them.

blocking.description: Sorted, de-duplicated keys of everything that put the verdict into judgment or pulled. Premise keys read 'premise-check: <VERDICT> <citation[:200]>'; reviewer keys read "<reviewer>: '<verdict>'"; other entries are the verbatim strings the op appends to its substantive or judgment list. Covered and stale premise rows never appear. Optional: two pulls compare by comparing their blocking sets.

reason.description: One-line statement of why the verdict holds.
